snippet.title: Jumpstart Pre-K Full Playthrough
snippet.description:
Jumpstart Pre-K Full Playthrough

Jumpstart Pre-K or JumpStart Pre-kindergarten is a game released in 1996 by Knowledge Adventure. It focus on skills for a pre-kindergarten level.

n this game, the player explores the Pre-K town and plays activities with the characters from JumpStart Preschool. Each time the player wins a game, they get a star. When the player gets four stars, they receive an item that they can place in the town's park. The player can freely arrange their items in the park.

There are three difficulty levels for each game, and the difficulty level can be adjusted at any time.
